items.title: Follow-up round-up on all 5 outstanding items from 8 Sep
items.detail: Combined follow-up on everything still open from the 8 Sep meeting: (1) Comms -- chase Louise on sign-off of the Marcos-to-PeopleXD-users email, plus her separate senior-staff university cascade item. (2) Data -- confirm Sarah's data availability analysis has actually gone across to Mel on SharePoint (her access was approved just before 8 Sep; this is not the same document as Sarah's separate data-completeness spreadsheet, which is Kevin's own action). (3) Dashboard build -- check progress on the two outstanding sections: annual leave calculations (fixed close-days logic needs revisiting) and under-reporting/possible missing staff-group data (~56 of ~15,000 FTE falling out of the logic on two short lists, cause not yet identified); target was end of September, ahead of the 9 Oct survey release. (4) Bulletin -- confirm whether Simon's open-ended sickness-absence prompt (asking departments to close genuinely resolved long-term cases before the next data pull) made it into this month's bulletin. (5) Dashboard review -- check whether Chris or Michelle have flagged anything from reviewing the live test-server dashboard.
